title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/ACCELERATION (1,010,400 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: MULTIPURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS.  THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   DRIVERS CAN MISTAKENLY STEP ON THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL WHEN THEY INTEND TO STEP ON THE BRAKE PEDAL.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (30 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER'S POSITION.  TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/REMOTE POWER MIRROR SWITCH (610,000 affected)
summary: A SHORT CIRCUIT CONDITION CAN OCCUR IN THE REMOTE POWER MIRROR CONTROL SWITCH CIRCUIT BOARD AS A RESULT OF A SEPARATED PART OF THE CONTACT ASSEMBLY BRIDGING THE SWITCH POSITIVE BATTERY PAD AND ADJACENT CHASSIS GROUND PAD.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/TRANSMISSION COOLING LINE (960,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN HIGH LOAD OPERATING CONDITIONS, THE TRANSMISSION FLUID TEMPERATURE CAN EXCEED THE MELTING POINT OF THE MATERIAL USED IN THE CONNECTOR TO RETAIN THE FLUID LINE TO THE TRANSMISSION.

title: ATHEY PRODUCTS CORP.: ATHEY/ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (70 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER'S POSITION.  TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Charles Machine Works, Inc.: CHARLES MACHINE/TRAILERS (88 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILERS.      INCORRECT SEALS WERE INSTALLED IN THE WHEEL ASSEMBLIES.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/FMVSS 217 (4,037 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.     SIDE EMERGENCY PUSH-OUT WINDOWS MAY NOT OPEN PROPERLY DUE TO INTERFERENCE WITH EXTERIOR BOW CAP.  EMERGENCY DOOR(S) MAY NOT HAVE REQUIRED OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS LOCATED ADJACENT TO INTERIOR DOOR HANDLE.  THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/SEAT BACK BOLT (148,000 affected)
summary: THE LOWER SEAT BACK ATTACHING BOLT ON THE DRIVER'S SEAT CAN FAIL AND SEPARATE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/DOOR LATCH (46,000 affected)
summary: EXCESS LUBRICATION CAN CAUSE THE RUBBER DOOR LATCH SWITCH COVER TO DEFORM, AND THE DOOR LATCH SWITCH TO MALFUNCTION, SO THAT THE SHOULDER BELT ANCHORAGE WOULD REMAIN AT THE A-PILLAR WHEN THE DOOR WAS CLOSED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/DRIVER'S SIDE GUIDE RAIL (24,000 affected)
summary: THE GUIDE RAIL ON THE DRIVER'S SIDE CONTAINS A COVERED CABLE AND ALSO AN ANGLED BELT GUIDE AT THE TOP END OF THE WEBBING.  THE COMBINATION OF THESE FACTORS CAN LEAD, OVER TIME, TO THE CABLE'S MOVEMENT EXERTING ABRADING FORCE TO THE LOWER EDGES OF THE CABLE'S CHAMBER, SUFFICIENT TO CAUSE THE CABLE TO DROP OUT OF THE CHAMBER WITH THE SHOULDER BELT ANCHORAGE BECOMING STUCK.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI MOTORS/HEADREST BRACKET (119 affected)
summary: THE HEADREST GUIDE BRACKET WAS IMPROPERLY WELDED TO THE SEAT BACK FRAME ON THE PASSENGER SIDE SEAT BACK ASSEMBLIES ONLY.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/LIFTGATE SUPPORT BRACKET (436,000 affected)
summary: THE BOLTS USED TO ATTACH THE STRUT TO THE BODY AND THE REAR LIFTGATE CAN ACCUMULATE FATIGUE DAMAGE IF THREE FACTORS COMBINE.  IF THE BOLT IS LOOSE, THE GAS STRUT IS OVER-PRESSURIZED, AND THE FREQUENCY OF OPENING AND CLOSING CYCLES IS HIGHER THAN FOR THE AVERAGE CUSTOMER, THE BOLT CAN FAIL.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/AIR BAG (125,000 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT DESIGN ALLOWS THE POTENTIAL FOR AN INADVERTENT AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT UPON VEHICLE IGNITION SHUT DOWN.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/DOOR LATCHES (1,352 affected)
summary: A SECONDARY BEND OPERATION WAS NOT PERFORMED DURING ASSEMBLY OF THE DOOR LATCH WHICH COULD CAUSE THE DOOR LATCH TO JAM WHEN LOCKED.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/FRONT AXLE BRAKE HOSES (464 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AXLE BRAKE HOSES WERE DAMAGED DURING TRANSPORTATION OF THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY WITH THE BRAKE HOSES ATTACHED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FRONT AXLE BRAKE HOSES (266 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AXLE BRAKE HOSES WERE DAMAGED DURING TRANSPORTATION OF THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY WITH THE BRAKE HOSES ATTACHED.

title: DRAW-TITE, INC.: DRAW-TITE/HITCH FRACTURE (1,652 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  CAST HEAD TRUNNION WEIGHT-DISTRIBUTING HITCHES.    THE CAST HEAD CAN FRACTURE, CAUSING THE BALL PLATFORM TO BREAK AWAY.

title: SAFARI MOTOR COACHES, INC.: SAFARI/PROPANE WATER HEATER LOCATION (10 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS-C MINI MOTOR HOMES.    THE PROPANE WATER HEATER IS LOCATED LESS THAN 3 FEET FROM THE GASOLINE FILLER SPOUT.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/AUTO TRANSMISSION (2,833 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MEDIUM AND HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS, SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES BUILT WITH A BENDIX 9X3 POWER APPLY PARK BRAKE SYSTEM.  THE CAM LEVER OF THE POWERED APPLY BRAKE CAN MOVE FORWARD, BECAUSE A HOLE IN THE TRANSMISSION MOUNTING BOSS WAS DRILLED TOO DEEP.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTO TRANSMISSION SHIFT LINKAGE (2,400 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS AND SCHOOL BUS CHASSIS-COWLS EQUIPPED WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS.   THE WELDS THAT ATTACH THE KEY TO THE TOP OF THE STEERING COLUMN MOUNTED AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LINKAGE MAY NOT ADEQUATELY RETAIN THE KEY, ALLOWING THE TRANSMISSION TO BE IN A GEAR OTHER THAN THAT INDICATED ON THE "PRNDL", OR IN SOME CASES, "RNDL."

title: MESA: MESA ENVIRONMENTAL/CNG ENGINES (1 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION: ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULES INSTALLED ON A MACK REFUSE TRUCK.     THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECM) IN THESE ENGINES CONTAIN A MANUFACTURING DEFECT WHICH RESULTS IN INTERMITTENT ELECTRICAL CONTACT AND CAUSES INCORRECT ELECTRONIC SIGNALS TO BE SENT TO THE ENGINE THROTTLE CONTROL.

title: Taylor Made Ambulances: TAYLOR MADE/FRAME RAIL CRACK (12 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  AMBULANCES BUILT TO THE SPECIFICATIONS OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS, ON A FREIGHTLINER FL-60 CHASSIS.  THE REAR CHASSIS FRAME RAIL CRACKS BEHIND THE REAR AXLE.

title: REXWORKS INC.: REXWORKS/BRAKE HOSES (421 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRUCK MIXERS.    THE BOOSTER TAG AXLE HAS AN AIR BRAKE SYSTEM WHICH WORKS ALONG WITH THE TRUCK'S VEHICLE BRAKE SYSTEM.  NYLON AIR TUBING USED TO OPERATE THE MIXER TAG AXLE AIR BRAKES CAN FAIL.
